sourceImages.description: Full rank ladder chart for the 2nd Footguards, showing dark-maroon shoulder-board insignia for each rank in three tiers. Commissioned Officers: Col (gold star, 3 small stars above), Maj (oak leaf), Capt (double bar), Lt (gold bar), Ens (silver bar). Non-Commissioned Officers: CSM (4 chevrons), CSgt (3 chevrons + ball), Sgt (3 chevrons), Cpl (2 chevrons + ball). Enlisted: ChM (3 bars), Rgl (2 bars), Pte (1 bar), Cdt (plain), Rct (plain). No member names, ranks only.

sourceImages.description: Mount & Blade: Napoleonic Wars first-person-view screenshot (May 2014, captioned 'Soon'): a line of British redcoats on a grassy hillside aiming muskets/pistols to the right; a white-bearded officer in the foreground. Round red Footguards-style crown emblems float above two soldiers. Round timer top-right reads 56:09; flag counters show Britain 1, France 1. A green kill feed in the lower-left lists five kill events, which is where all names below were read.

sourceImages.description: Linebattle screenshot with an editor title banner reading '2nd Coldstream Guards' across the top: a column of red-coated guards with red-and-white checkered markers advancing along a dry hillside, viewed from behind a soldier. One floating nametag is readable over a mid-frame soldier (verified by crop/upscale): 2ndCS_A2_Rd_Gooner.

Mount & Blade: Warband Napoleonic Wars first-person screenshot on a snowy map, bayonet-fixed musket in view, soldiers fighting mid-distance. A ~16-line kill feed occupies the upper left (killer -> weapon icon -> victim). Read from 6x/10x zoomed crops; text is heavily JPEG-degraded so certainty varies per name. Regiment tags visible in the feed include 2ndCS, 88thRG, 63e, 59th_IJA, 44staHM, 23rd (Highlanders), 9me... (Schutzen-like tag), and a GRE (grenadier) tag. A few lines were too destroyed to transcribe at all: a '05th_Spec_a...' vs '..._dragoons_...' line, a '2ndCS_Cpl_...' victim, a '44staHM_Maj_M...' killer, and a '44staHM_Mar_C...' victim cut off at the screen edge.
